title: Marlowe Rewards Bonus Points Schedule
content:
Besides points on purchases, Marlowe Rewards members receive bonus points of fixed sizes: a welcome bonus, a birthday bonus, product-review bonuses and referral bonuses. The schedule below gives the size, limits and timing of each at every tier.

## Amounts that vary by tier

| Tier | Birthday bonus (points) | Referral bonus per qualifying referral (points) |
|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Member | 0 (no birthday bonus) | 1000 |
| Marlowe Rewards Silver | 250 | 1000 |
| Marlowe Rewards Gold | 400 | 1000 |
| Marlowe Rewards Platinum | 600 | 1500 |
| Marlowe Rewards Icon | 1000 | 1500 |
| Marlowe Rewards Atelier | 1500 | 2000 |

A birthday bonus of 0 means the tier receives no birthday bonus.

## Terms common to every tier

| Bonus | Term | Every tier |
|---|---|---|
| Welcome | Points posted once per customer lifetime, at first enrolment | 500 |
| Birthday | Minimum calendar days a membership must have been enrolled before the birthday-bonus posting date | 30 |
| Birthday | Day of the birth month on which the birthday bonus posts | 1 |
| Product review | Points per published product review of a verified purchase | 50 |
| Product review | Most review bonuses posted in one calendar month | 4 |
| Product review | The reviewed product must appear on a dispatched order of the member | Yes |
| Referral | Most referral bonuses posted per calendar year | 10 |
| Referral | Minimum merchandise value of the referred friend's first order, after discounts and before tax and shipping | 75.00 USD |
| Referral | Calendar days after the friend's first order is dispatched before the referral bonus posts | 30 |

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical members)

- A Marlowe Rewards Gold member's birthday bonus is 400 points. A Marlowe Rewards Member's is nothing, because the Member tier carries 0.
- A friend's first order with 74.99 USD of merchandise after discounts is below the 75.00 minimum; one with 75.00 meets it.
- A member who publishes six verified reviews in one calendar month reaches the monthly limit of 4 review bonuses.
